Theo (AE): Quick sync: FinTrust wants a 2-week POC and they require EU-only processing + a list of subprocessors. Also asking if we can pin to specific regions (eu-west1 and eu-central1) and what happens on capacity shortfalls.
Maya (SE): We can pin via routing_policy but fallback must be explicit. Options: fail-closed (return 429/503) or allow cross-region standby (violates strict EU). They asked for sample config + curl example.
Hannah (Legal): I will draft the subproc CSV. Need to state control-plane telemetry location and confirm no payloads/PII leave EU. If they accept fail-closed, we need that in the SOW.
Ravi (SRE): Technical note: data plane (inference) stays in pinned EU regions. Small routing/health telemetry currently goes to our US control plane; we can mark it as anonymized. For quick POC, we cannot re-home control plane. Cost note: pinned routing -> ~10-15% uplift.
Maya (SE): Sample snippet to share:
routing_policy:
  mode: pin-list
  regions: [eu-west1, eu-central1]
  fallback: none   # fail-closed
  cache_scope: regional

Maya (SE): Example curl: curl -X POST https://eu-west1.api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" -d '{"input":"test"}'
Theo (AE): Deadline: customer needs subproc list + config + one-liner on fail behavior by tomorrow morning. Can we commit?
Hannah (Legal): I'll upload subproc CSV and a compliance paragraph (control-plane telemetry is operational only) by EOD tonight.
Ravi (SRE): I'll provide a one-page network path and the cost uplift estimate. Opening routing ticket now.
bot: Ticket PRESALES-9982 created. Owner: Ravi. ETA: 48h.
Theo (AE): Thanks team 44D will bundle and send once everything is uploaded.
